title: Reconcile vendor invoices in Accounts Payable

claims.claim: You must have the finance_ap or admin role to open Accounts Payable.

checks.note: a role gate on the page or its route would name finance_ap

claims.finding: The page is gated only by the Inventory feature: user-routes.tsx:2276-2280 wraps <AccountsPayablePage /> in <FeatureAccess feature="Inventory">, and AccountsPayablePage.tsx has no role check. Any role with the Inventory feature (e.g. clinician, vendor_coordinator) can open it. The write actions are role-gated: ap-match-invoice-line, ap-record-payment, ap-open-dispute and ap-resolve-dispute allow only admin, finance_ap and superadmin (index.ts:9-10).
claims.proposed_text: Anyone whose role has the Inventory feature can open Accounts Payable. Matching lines, recording payments, and opening or resolving disputes need the finance_ap or admin role.
claims.reason: The page is gated by the Inventory feature only; finance_ap/admin gate the write actions. Replaced by inv-ap-26 and inv-ap-27.

claims.claim: The products on the invoice should already exist in the Product Catalog and have been received into inventory.
claims.finding: Advice, not product behaviour. Nothing in the Inbox or Matching code (AccountsPayablePage.tsx, InvoiceLineMatchRow.tsx, ap-match-invoice-line) checks invoice lines against the catalog or against received stock, so no code check can confirm it.

claims.claim: The finance_ap role grants access to Accounts Payable and to cost data in inventory.

checks.note: a grant tied to finance_ap would be checked in the AP page or the inventory pages

claims.finding: No inventory page or the AP page checks finance_ap. Access is by the Inventory feature flag (FeatureAccess); finance_ap's real effect is on the AP write edge functions (ALLOWED_ROLES in ap-*/index.ts:9-10). No cost-data gate tied to finance_ap was found.
claims.proposed_text: The finance_ap role can match invoice lines, record payments, and open or resolve disputes in Accounts Payable.
claims.reason: No page checks finance_ap; the role's effect is on the AP write actions. Replaced by inv-ap-27.

claims.claim: Users with only vendor_coordinator or clinical roles see inventory units but not cost or AP information.

checks.note: hiding AP from these roles would need a role check in the AP page

claims.finding: AccountsPayablePage.tsx has no role check; the route needs only the Inventory feature (user-routes.tsx:2276-2280), which vendor_coordinator and clinical roles have (ROLE_PERMISSIONS.INVENTORY_ACCESS, _shared/auth-helpers.ts:307). They can open AP and see invoices; only the write calls are refused.
claims.proposed_text: Remove the sentence, or: Users without finance_ap or admin can open Accounts Payable if their role has the Inventory feature, but cannot match, pay, or dispute invoices.
claims.reason: Any role with the Inventory feature can open AP and see invoices; only the writes are refused. Replaced by inv-ap-26 and inv-ap-27.

claims.claim: Assign finance_ap in Administrator → Organization Role Config to staff responsible for invoice reconciliation.

checks.note: assigning a role to a person would write user roles from this page

claims.finding: Organization Role Config (OrgRoleConfigPage.tsx) sets which features each role may open (upsertAllRoleConfigs over a ROLES list that includes finance_ap, lines 26-37). It does not assign roles to users. A user's role is picked on the user record, e.g. FacilityUsersPage.tsx:80 { value: "finance_ap", label: "Finance AP" }.
claims.proposed_text: Give staff the Finance AP role on their user record. Administrator → Organization Role Config sets which features each role, including finance_ap, can open.
claims.reason: Organization Role Config sets features per role; it does not assign roles to users. Replaced by inv-ap-28.

claims.claim: Open Accounts Payable from the Inventory Management hub.
Accounts Payable is at the route /facility/{facility_uuid}/inventory/accounts-payable.
claims.finding: There is no facility-scoped AP route. The page is at /inventory/accounts-payable (user-routes.tsx:2276) and the hub tile links there (InventoryManagement.tsx). /facility/:facilityId/billing/accounts-payable is a different page (ClinicApPage).
claims.proposed_text: Open Accounts Payable from the Inventory Management hub (route /inventory/accounts-payable).
claims.reason: There is no facility-scoped AP route; the page is at /inventory/accounts-payable. Route sentence deleted; inv-ap-06 covers the hub tile.

claims.claim: The workspace is organized into tabs: Inbox, Matching, Payments, Disputes, Activity, and Reports.
The Inbox holds incoming vendor invoices awaiting triage.
On the Matching tab you match invoice lines to received shipments; unmatched lines are surfaced so you can reconcile quantities and prices.

checks.note: matching against shipments would read shipment data

claims.finding: Matching never reads shipments. The tab lists unmatched invoice lines with product, SKU, lot, box UID, quantity, unit cost, patient, provider and case (InvoiceLineMatchRow.tsx:108-119), and the user marks each one Match, Review, or Override (InvoiceLineMatchRow.tsx:136-150). The lines are tied to use events and billing links, not shipments.
claims.proposed_text: The Matching tab lists every unmatched invoice line with its product, SKU, lot, quantity, cost, patient and provider. Mark each line Match, Review, or Override.
claims.reason: Matching never reads shipments; users mark each line Match, Review, or Override. Replaced by inv-ap-29.

claims.claim: On the Payments tab you record payments against matched, approved invoices — including partial payments; an invoice can sit in a partially-paid state until the balance is cleared.
Open a dispute when an invoice doesn't reconcile, and work it on the Disputes tab.
Resolve a dispute by re-matching against a corrected invoice or by recording the vendor's credit.

checks.note: a re-match outcome would appear in the resolve flow

claims.finding: A dispute is resolved with one of three outcomes: credit_issued, invoice_voided, invoice_upheld (AccountsPayablePage.tsx Disputes tab; shown as "credit issued", "invoice voided", "invoice upheld"). credit_issued and invoice_voided set the invoice to cancelled; invoice_upheld sets it back to matched (ap-resolve-dispute/index.ts:86-94). There is no re-match against a corrected invoice.
claims.proposed_text: Resolve a dispute with one of three outcomes: credit issued or invoice voided (the invoice is cancelled), or invoice upheld (the invoice returns to matched).
claims.reason: Disputes resolve with credit issued, invoice voided, or invoice upheld; there is no re-match. Replaced by inv-ap-32.

claims.claim: The Activity tab is the audit trail of AP actions across invoices.
The Reports tab shows per-vendor rollups — total invoiced, total paid, total disputed, and match rate.
In the Inbox, review each incoming invoice — vendor, invoice number, date, and amount — and open it to see its lines.

checks.note: showing lines in the opened invoice would render line rows outside the Matching tab

claims.finding: Opening an Inbox invoice shows a drawer with invoice #, status, invoice date, due date, total, ownership and notes, plus Begin Matching and Open Dispute (AccountsPayablePage.tsx drawer). The lines themselves are not shown; the list card shows only a line count. Line rows appear only on the Matching tab.
claims.proposed_text: In the Inbox, review each incoming invoice — vendor, invoice number, date, line count, and amount. Open it to see its details, then click Begin Matching.
claims.reason: The Inbox drawer shows invoice details, not lines; lines are on the Matching tab. Replaced by inv-ap-30.

claims.claim: Lines whose quantity and price agree reconcile cleanly; the Unmatched Lines view lists anything that doesn't.

checks.note: automatic reconciliation would compare quantity or price

claims.finding: Nothing compares quantity or price. ap-match-invoice-line only sets match_status to what the user chose (matched, needs_review, overridden; index.ts:44) and sets the invoice to matched once every line is matched or overridden (index.ts:106-107). A line stays on Unmatched Lines until a person acts on it.
claims.proposed_text: A line stays on the Unmatched Lines list until someone marks it Match or Override. When every line is matched or overridden, the invoice becomes matched.
claims.reason: Nothing compares quantity or price; lines stay unmatched until someone marks them. Replaced by inv-ap-31.

claims.claim: Once an invoice is matched and reviewed, approve it so it's eligible for payment.

checks.note: an approve step would have an Approve control in the AP workspace

claims.finding: The Inventory AP workspace has no Approve action. Matched invoices go straight onto the Payments tab (status filter at AccountsPayablePage.tsx:215 includes matched). Approval exists only on the separate clinic AP page (/facility/:facilityId/billing/accounts-payable, via clinic-invoice-respond).
claims.proposed_text: Once every line is matched, the invoice appears on the Payments tab, ready for payment.
claims.reason: This workspace has no Approve action; matched invoices go straight to Payments. Replaced by inv-ap-33.

claims.claim: On the Payments tab, record a full or partial payment (Record Payment).
Invoices move through states such as matched, approved, partially paid, paid, and disputed.
Marking an invoice paid removes it from the outstanding-payables view.

checks.note: the Payments (Awaiting Payment) list excludes paid

claims.claim: Receiving a shipment (through a category tile) creates the inventory units (UINs); Accounts Payable reconciles and pays the vendor invoice for those units.

checks.note: the receiving edge function (inventory-import-batches, used by Manual Receive and bulk receiving) would write a per-unit UIN

claims.finding: The category tiles open /inventory-management/product-batches/<category>, whose receiving flows (ManualReceiveModal, BulkUploadOrderModal, inventory-import-batches) create inventory_product_batches_v2 rows. That table has no UIN column; UIN exists only on the legacy amniotic_inventory_items / biologics_inventory_items tables.
claims.proposed_text: Receiving a shipment through a category tile creates the inventory records (lots) in stock; Accounts Payable reconciles and pays the vendor invoice for them.
claims.reason: Receiving creates lot records, not UINs. Replaced by inv-ap-35.

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: if Accounts Payable is not accessible, your role does not include finance_ap or admin.
claims.finding: Opening the page depends on the Inventory feature, not finance_ap/admin (user-routes.tsx:2276-2280). A user without the Inventory feature sees the Access Denied page with "Restricted: Inventory" (FeatureAccess.tsx).
claims.proposed_text: If Accounts Payable is not accessible, your role does not have the Inventory feature. Ask an admin to grant it in Administrator → Organization Role Config.
claims.reason: Opening the page depends on the Inventory feature, not finance_ap/admin. Replaced by inv-ap-36.

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: an invoice has unmatched lines because the received quantity or price differs from the invoice.
claims.finding: Lines are unmatched until a person marks them; no quantity or price comparison exists (ap-match-invoice-line/index.ts:38-46). Same root as inv-ap-17.
claims.proposed_text: An invoice has unmatched lines until someone marks each line Match or Override on the Matching tab; if the vendor is wrong, open a dispute.
claims.reason: No quantity or price comparison exists; lines are unmatched until marked. Replaced by inv-ap-37.

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: if a vendor's match rate looks low, review the vendor's recent invoices on Reports.

checks.note: a per-invoice list on Reports would render each report row's invoice number

claims.finding: The Reports tab ("Vendor Spend Summary (YTD)") shows one aggregate row per vendor — Vendor, Total Invoiced, Total Paid, Total Disputed, Match Rate — and no list of invoices (AccountsPayablePage.tsx Reports section). Match rate = (matched + paid) / all invoices.
claims.proposed_text: If a vendor's match rate looks low on Reports, review that vendor's invoices on the Inbox and Matching tabs and follow up with the vendor.
claims.reason: Reports shows one aggregate row per vendor, not invoices. Replaced by inv-ap-38.

claims.claim: Anyone whose role has the Inventory feature can open Accounts Payable and see the invoices.

checks.note: no role check on the page

claims.claim: Matching lines, recording payments, and opening or resolving disputes need the Finance AP or admin role; other users can look but cannot do these steps.

Give staff who reconcile invoices the Finance AP role on their user record. Administrator → Organization Role Config sets which features each role, including finance ap, can open; it does not assign roles to people.

Inbox lists Received Invoices, with Add Invoice to enter one by hand. Matching lists Unmatched Lines — each line still unmatched, with product, SKU, lot, box UID, quantity, unit cost, line total, patient, and provider — and you mark each Match, Review, or Override. Payments lists Awaiting Payment (matched, approved, and partially paid invoices). Reports shows Vendor Spend Summary (YTD).

In the Inbox, review each incoming invoice — vendor, invoice number, date, line count, and amount. Open it to see its details (invoice number, status, invoice and due dates, total), then click Begin Matching.

Medipyxis does not compare quantities or prices; a line stays on Unmatched Lines until someone marks it, and a line marked Review leaves the list the next time it loads. When every line is matched or overridden, the invoice becomes matched.

checks.note: the match action never reads quantity or cost

claims.claim: Open Dispute asks for a reason and makes the invoice disputed. On the Disputes tab, resolve with credit issued or invoice voided (the invoice is cancelled) or invoice upheld (the invoice returns to matched).

Matched invoices appear on the Payments tab. Record Payment asks for payment date, amount, method (ACH, Check, Wire, Credit, or Other), and reference. A payment smaller than the total leaves the invoice partially paid.

checks.note: no approve action in this workspace

claims.claim: Receiving a shipment through a category tile creates the inventory records (lots) in stock; Accounts Payable reconciles and pays the vendor invoice for them.
Troubleshooting: if Accounts Payable is not accessible, your role does not have the Inventory feature; you see Access Denied with Restricted: Inventory.

Troubleshooting: an invoice still has unmatched lines until someone marks each line Match or Override on the Matching tab; Match, Record Payment, or Open Dispute fail for roles other than Finance AP or admin.
Troubleshooting: if a vendor's match rate looks low on Reports, review that vendor's invoices on the Inbox and Matching tabs and follow up with the vendor.
